inputs.text: Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan on Saturday is denying there is any Rs 700 crore corruption in the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, insisting the accusations are politically motivated. This is the usual dodge from left-wing leaders who protect their power rather than face real accountability. These progressive setups breed waste and graft by turning away from personal responsibility and traditional structures that enforce order. We need to demand honest governance rooted in national integrity and family values instead of letting excuses shield the rot.
